name: Certified Multi-Rail Semantic Compiler
purpose: Preserve one exact Clay semantic spine while compiling operation- and reader-specific discrete or latent cognition/communication rails with distinct proof obligations, explicit loss budgets and deterministic re-entry to canonical proposals before authority/effects.
pipeline: P1 canonical Clay + COVE causal slice / CognitiveEpochCapsule
existing CBCC/COVE basis, projection, capability and effect checks

state_contracts.invariant: rail selection may optimize cost/reader fit but cannot enlarge trusted semantic closure, remove hard requirements or grant authority
receipt binds both source semantics and exact emitted view; source hash alone is insufficient; hash identity is still not semantic correctness without validation
latent payload identity/provenance does not prove semantic equivalence, truth, role identity or authority
output from any rail is proposal state only
reconciliation validates return-to-canonical meaning but cannot mint facts or capabilities

operations.executor: deterministic heuristic, learned optimizer or LLM may rank candidate rails
operations.rule: hard semantic/effect constraints are supplied by trusted COVE/ICSL and cannot be waived
emit bounded reader view and dual-binding receipt; all effect-critical required semantics must remain covered
validate exact emitted view against canonical required semantics and declared loss budget
record payload/alignment/provenance; never claim semantic equivalence solely from latent identity

operations.executor: deterministic checks plus model/domain/oracle evidence as required
operations.rule: discrete rail may support structural roundtrip; latent rail requires canonical reconstruction plus adequacy/causal controls before consequential use

LATENT_NATIVE: exact semantic anchors for any claimed referents
substitution/lesion or equivalent causal-use control for scientific claims
rail_proof_obligations.HYBRID: must satisfy obligations of each participating rail and preserve stage identity

claygraph_mapping.latent_activation_field: memory salience prior only; separate epoch and causal stage from model latent rail
claygraph_mapping.model_discrete_view: versioned local handle/codebook projection with exact anchor map
claygraph_mapping.model_latent_channel: transient cognition/communication payload; store receipts/anchors, not latent bytes as canonical truth
claygraph_mapping.reconciliation: durable memory accepts only typed canonical proposal through ordinary epistemic/authority gates

gwt_mapping: Rail/view identity is an orthogonal causal factor after canonical candidate/workspace semantics and before reader uptake; lesions must pin or independently vary rail plan/projection/alignment.
hyperposition_mapping: Semantic class and role identity survive every rail through exact anchors; compact handles are implementation forms, not new authority domains.
emergence_mapping: Protocol convergence, latent performance or cross-rail agreement do not establish emergence; E-CERT2 causal identity/lesion/rescue/OOD gates remain required.
evidence_boundary: Supported by current RAE C6/G10/CC10/H4/GWT4/E1/ClayGraph C4, direct NVIDIA generic-4B reader measurements, local CC11 fuzz/derived analyses, and independent compiler/agent/latent-communication literature. No target-Qwen full-FT or live-FRANK promotion.
